units.source_text: “从高山俯瞰谷底，瓜儿和茄子的花盛开……初学尺八，首先要学这个。

en.t: “Looking down into the valley from a high mountain, the flowers of melons and eggplants are in full bloom... When first learning the shakuhachi, this is what one must learn first.

units.source_text: 有一种乐器比尺八少一个洞，叫作竖笛。”

en.t: There is an instrument with one fewer hole than the shakuhachi, called a vertical flute.”
